tools.name: AddDut
tools.description: Create a DUT (Struct / Enum / Union / Alias) in <Plc> Project^DUTs, write its declaration (TYPE ... END_TYPE from Fields / AliasType; an Enum without Fields gets enum_member := 0) and read it back. data: path, objectKind (DUT), itemType (605 Enum / 606 Struct / 607 Union / 623 Alias), declaration. A name that already exists or a declaration that reads back different -> DUT_CREATE_FAILED. Change it later with WritePouCode Declaration only (a DUT has no implementation). BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a created DUT (also one whose readback failed) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the DUT; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

DutType.description: DUT type: Struct, Enum, Alias, Union.

Fields.description: Optional object of field declarations (name = type) for Struct/Union (name = value for Enum). Declaration order is not guaranteed (PowerShell hashtable).

tools.name: AddGvl
tools.description: Create a GVL in <Plc> Project^GVLs, write VAR_GLOBAL ... END_VAR from Variables and read it back. data: path, objectKind (GVL), itemType 615, declaration. A name that already exists or a declaration that reads back different -> GVL_CREATE_FAILED. Change it later with WritePouCode Declaration only (a GVL has no implementation). BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a created GVL (also one whose readback failed) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the GVL; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

Variables.description: Optional object of variable declarations (name = type). Declaration order is not guaranteed (PowerShell hashtable).

tools.name: AddLibrary
tools.description: Add a library reference to the PLC project (References node). BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): the added reference (also when CreateChild failed) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the library; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

Version.description: Optional library version. Uses latest if omitted.

tools.name: AddPou
tools.description: Create a POU (Program, FunctionBlock or Function, language ST) in <Plc> Project^POUs (or PlcProjectPath) and read it back: success only when the new item is found with the expected kind. data: path, folderPath, objectKind (POU), itemType (602 Program / 603 Function / 604 FunctionBlock), language (read back from the new item, must be ST), declaration (default header written by XAE; a Function header must contain : ReturnType). Then fill it with WritePouCode. A POU / DUT / GVL / ITF with the same name anywhere in the same PLC project -> POU_CREATE_FAILED with its path (nothing created; data.duplicateCheckScope = project, or folder when the project has more than 3000 nodes); a failed readback names the step and that the object stays in the tree (error.hint says what to do). A modal dialog in XAE -> IDE_MODAL_DIALOG before anything is created. BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a created POU (also one whose readback failed) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the POU; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

Type.description: POU type: Program, FunctionBlock, or Function.

ReturnType.description: Return type for Functions (e.g., INT, BOOL). Ignored for Program/FunctionBlock.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path of the folder the POU is created in, e.g. TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs (same on 4024 and 4026). Omit to auto-detect (<Plc> Project^POUs, else the <Plc> Project node; see data.folderPath).

tools.name: BuildProject
tools.description: Build the PLC project of the open solution and wait for the result. On BUILD_FAILED read data.codeErrors (description/file/line taken from the XAE Error List) instead of guessing. data.errors counts CODE errors only; missing / unresolved libraries (Library Manager rows such as "Could not open library") are counted separately in data.libraryErrors and listed in data.libraryErrorItems. With library errors the PLC code may not have been compiled at all (no code error is then reported), so a build that would otherwise succeed returns LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED (success=false, buildSucceeded=null, codeVerified=false): install the missing libraries in the XAE Library Manager first; AllowUnresolvedLibrary=true accepts it as success with data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED. data.codeVerified=true means the Error List was read, lists no library error and no code row without a line, and every PLC project took part in the build: a PLC project skipped by the configuration (or none in the solution) gives codeVerified=false and data.warningCodes [PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION, CODE_NOT_VERIFIED] (#58); a success that is not verified that way (Error List unreadable, unlocated code rows) carries data.warningCode=CODE_NOT_VERIFIED. data.warningCodes lists every warning code (data.warningCode is the first). Breaking change (#23): data.errors no longer includes Library Manager rows. data.errorItems keeps every Error List error, each with category code | library | other (other = no file, e.g. a build-summary row). data.decidedBy says what decided buildSucceeded (LastBuildInfo, else ErrorList). Warnings come with their contents: data.warningItems (same shape) and data.codeWarnings (without Library Manager items), unless data.errorListError is set. A full build can take several minutes: the build is started asynchronously and SolutionBuild.BuildState is polled (the synchronous VS2022 call never returns); TimeoutSec (default 600) bounds the wait, after which BUILD_TIMEOUT is returned; a modal dialog that appears during the build is returned as IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. Requires ConnectIde with an open solution. Coverage: data.projects lists every PLC project (.plcproj) with status built / skipped / failed / unknown (from the active solution configuration, DTE SolutionContext.ShouldBuild), data.skippedProjects and data.coverageComplete. data.solutionConfiguration is '<configuration>|<solution platform>' read like GetIdeInfo (data.solutionPlatform equals GetIdeInfo solutionPlatform), data.projectPlatform the .tsproj project platform, data.platformSource how the solution platform was read (with 'context' solutionConfiguration is the configuration name only); each PLC project's own platform is data.projects[].platform. BUILD_REQUIRED (after a platform switch, or after a build that was not a complete success) is cleared only by a build with coverageComplete=true and codeVerified=true (or an AllowUnresolvedLibrary build with library rows only; data.completeBuild=true). A build that ends LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, BUILD_FAILED, BUILD_STATUS_UNKNOWN, BUILD_TIMEOUT or IDE_MODAL_DIALOG after it started, or succeeds with completeBuild=false records BUILD_REQUIRED for the solution (data.buildRequired; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written), so EnableConfig and PlcLogin refuse until a complete build (#56; not for a solution without PLC project). With accepted library rows and a code row without a line number data.warningCodes has LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and CODE_NOT_VERIFIED. A PLC project that the active solution configuration does not build (no Build.0 in the .sln) is skipped silently by XAE while it still says Build succeeded: the result keeps success but sets data.warningCode=PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION and data.warning. ExpectedProject=[names] makes a skipped project a failure (PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION, build not started), an unknown name EXPECTED_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND; use it whenever a specific PLC (e.g. a unit-test PLC) must be compiled.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the build to finish (BuildState = Done); BUILD_TIMEOUT after that. Default 600.

ExpectedProject.description: PLC project name(s) that must be compiled, e.g. ["FrameworkUnitTest"] (the .plcproj file name without extension). Skipped by the active solution configuration -> PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION (build not started); not in the solution -> EXPECTED_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a build whose Error List shows unresolved libraries as success (data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, codeVerified=false) instead of returning LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED. Only when the user accepts that the PLC code may not have been compiled.

tools.name: CleanProject
tools.description: Clean the open solution (Build > Clean Solution) and wait until SolutionBuild.BuildState is Done (TimeoutSec default 300 -> CLEAN_TIMEOUT). Use instead of touching DTE yourself: issue #18 once hit a null-valued expression on Solution / SolutionBuild right after ConnectIde (cause not confirmed); this tool waits for them and counts the null answers (data.nullReads). A modal dialog returns IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. Readback SolutionBuild.LastBuildInfo: 0 -> success, data.cleanVerified=true; unreadable -> CLEAN_UNVERIFIED (always a failure); > 0 with only unresolved-library Error List rows (<plc>.Library Manager, no line) -> LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED (data.libraryErrorItems; a later BuildProject success may not have compiled the PLC code, #45), or with AllowUnresolvedLibrary=true success with data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and cleanVerified=false; any other error -> CLEAN_FAILED (data.errorItems). data: buildState, failedProjects, cleanVerified, cleanSec, nullReads, errorItems.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds for the clean (BuildState = Done). Default 300.

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a clean whose only errors are unresolved libraries ('<plc>.Library Manager'): success with data.warningCode = LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and data.cleanVerified = $false instead of the LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED error. Use only for a project known to miss libraries.

tools.name: ConnectAds
tools.description: Open the ADS connection to the PLC runtime. Leave AmsNetId empty: it is auto-detected from the IDE target and changes per target (local UmRT, remote CX ...), so never hardcode it. Port defaults to 851 (PLC runtime 1). Requires ConnectIde for auto-detection.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to auto-detect from the IDE target (recommended; it differs per target).

tools.name: ConnectIde
tools.description: Connect to a running TwinCAT XAE / Visual Studio instance (found through the Running Object Table); only if none is found does it launch a new XAE. SolutionPath is optional and opens that .sln after connecting. Call this before any project, build or runtime tool. Returns ideProcessId, connectSec (total seconds), launchSec (only when a new IDE was launched: seconds until DTE was ready) and, when a solution is open, the detected target AmsNetId. When the IDE that has SolutionPath open is blocked by a modal dialog or busy (its DTE answers RPC_E_CALL_REJECTED or an empty Version), it is recognised without COM and IDE_MODAL_DIALOG (or IDE_BUSY without a dialog) is returned with data.ideProcessId, data.dialog, data.matchedBy and data.attached; no second IDE is launched. matchedBy module-state (the IDE this server was connected to), session-record (an earlier ConnectIde saw this process with this solution) or dialog-path (the dialog names a file in the solution folder) attach that IDE (attached=true): GetIdeModalDialog / ResetSolution work on it right away. window-title (title = solution name only; may be a same-named copy elsewhere) does not attach (attached=false); when that IDE is not yours, LaunchIfBlocked=true ignores it and launches. After the dialog is closed the same ConnectIde call connects to it.

ProgId.description: COM ProgID to connect to / launch. When given, running instances with this ProgID are preferred and only this ProgID is used for launching.

SolutionPath.description: Path to a .sln file. If specified, the IDE will open this solution automatically after connecting (or connect to an instance already running this solution).

NoLaunch.description: If set, do not launch a new IDE instance if none is running.

LaunchIfBlocked.description: With -SolutionPath: ignore a blocked IDE that matches only by window title (matchedBy 'window-title', i.e. a same-named solution that may be someone else's) and go on as if it were not there (launch unless -NoLaunch). A blocked IDE recognised by strong evidence (module-state, session-record, dialog-path) is still reported.

tools.name: DisconnectAds
tools.description: Close the ADS connection and forget the cached endpoint (disables auto-reconnect).

tools.name: DisconnectIde
tools.description: Release the DTE/COM references held by the bridge. The IDE keeps running unless Quit=true, which closes the solution without saving and quits the IDE (only use on an IDE that ConnectIde launched). With Quit=true a modal dialog is checked first: if one is up nothing is attempted, nothing is released (the connection stays: for kind reload-prompt run ResetSolution, then DisconnectIde Quit=true again) and the result is IDE_QUIT_FAILED (data.dialog {title, text, kind, reloadTarget}, quit=false, disconnected=false); if DTE.Quit fails the result is also IDE_QUIT_FAILED (success=false, data.ideProcessId / quitError; the IDE process still runs). After a failure the IDE pid is kept, so DisconnectIde Quit=true Kill=true can follow directly without ConnectIde. Kill=true (only with Quit=true) kills the IDE process in those two cases, but only when this session launched it (data.ownedBySession, still true after the internal reconnect of ResetSolution), otherwise IDE_NOT_OWNED and nothing is killed; data.killed tells whether it was killed. COM references are always released.

Quit.description: true = also close the solution (without saving) and quit the IDE.

Kill.description: Only with Quit=true: kill the IDE process when it cannot be quit (modal dialog, DTE.Quit failed). Only for an IDE this session launched (data.ownedBySession); any other IDE -> IDE_NOT_OWNED, nothing killed.

tools.name: EnableConfig
tools.description: Activate the configuration on the target without any dialog. Restarts TwinCAT and downloads/starts the PLC program: the machine stops and restarts. Confirm with the user first. With Force=true it runs the whole lifecycle: Config -> Activate -> wait for Run -> PLC Login+Download -> wait for port 851 -> PLC Run, and reports every step in data.steps. NoLogin=true stops after TwinCAT is in Run (no download, no PLC Run). TwinCAT restarts, so call ConnectAds again afterwards (ReadVariable/WriteVariable also auto-reconnect; data.reconnected tells you). Never add sleeps around this call; it polls until the target state is reached. Before Activate the active solution platform is compared with the platform the target reports through TARGETINFO (ADS port 200, IG 0x700; data.platformCheck='target'), else with Platform when given ('parameter'); the solution platform and the project platform of its .tsproj must both match; on a mismatch the solution platform is switched and the project rebuilt (steps platform-fix, platform-fix-build; data.platformFixed=true; not part of TimeoutSec). NoPlatformFix=true returns PLATFORM_MISMATCH instead, before anything is activated. A solution platform with the right name whose .tsproj is built for another project platform makes the switch return PLATFORM_PROJECT_MISMATCH (data.platformMap, data.requestedProjectPlatform; fix the Configuration Manager). A target without TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702, e.g. the UmRT of TwinCAT 3.1.4026.21-22) and no Platform: platformCheck='skipped', data.warning set, Activate runs as before. data always has targetPlatform, targetPlatformSource (adsTargetInfo / unavailable), solutionPlatform, projectPlatform (.tsproj project platform), platformFixed, platformCheck. ACTIVATE_FAILED = ActivateConfiguration() returned but XAE reported failed projects ('Check config failed!'; nothing written to the target), usually because the active solution platform (data.solutionPlatform) differs from the target platform: retry with Platform ('TwinCAT OS (x64)' for a Usermode Runtime / UmRT or TwinCAT/BSD, 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' for a Windows RT target). Multi-PLC: every PLC project (or PlcProjectPath) is logged in and started on its own ADS port (851, 852, ...; data.plcs). After Activate the project _Boot package is compared with the Boot folder of a target on this PC (data.bootPackage, BOOT_PACKAGE_MISMATCH). Step verify reads back port 10000 and every PLC port at the end and checks for a modal dialog: anything not Run is RUNTIME_STATE_MISMATCH (data.finalCheck), never success; failures after Activate carry data.diagnostics (dialog, Error List rows, bootPackage). BUILD_REQUIRED (nothing activated): after a solution platform switch or after a BuildProject that was not a complete success (LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, BUILD_FAILED, completeBuild=false; #56) there was no complete BuildProject; Activate would compile by itself without anybody checking the result. Also after WritePouCode / AddPou / AddDut / AddGvl / AddLibrary / NewProject / ResetSolution changed the PLC code or project (kind code-changed, #65; error.hint names the tool and object). A solution never built or changed through these tools is not refused (known limit).

Force.description: true = full lifecycle without dialogs (Config -> Activate -> Run -> Login/Download -> PLC Run).

NoLogin.description: true = stop after TwinCAT reaches Run; skip PLC login/download/Run.

TimeoutSec.description: Overall time limit for the whole -Force cycle (single deadline). Default 120. The platform-fix / platform-fix-build steps run before the deadline starts.

NoPlatformFix.description: true = do not switch the solution platform; a mismatch with the target (or Platform) platform returns PLATFORM_MISMATCH before anything is activated.

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Passed to the build that follows an automatic platform switch: accept unresolved libraries (LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED) as success. It does not lift a BUILD_REQUIRED that a separate BuildProject recorded (#56): run BuildProject again. After a platform switch EnableConfig refuses to activate (BUILD_REQUIRED) until a complete BuildProject (data.completeBuild=true: coverageComplete and codeVerified=true, or AllowUnresolvedLibrary with library errors only); the BUILD_REQUIRED message says why the last build did not count.

Platform.description: Reference platform used only when the target does not report one through TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702): 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' for a Usermode Runtime / UmRT or TwinCAT/BSD, 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' for a Windows RT target. A platform the target reports wins.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC project(s) to log in and start, by name (["FrameworkUnitTest"]) or tree path. Default: every PLC project of the solution.

ActivateTimeoutSec.description: Deadline in seconds for ActivateConfiguration() (default 180, also bounded by TimeoutSec with Force). On timeout ACTIVATE_TIMEOUT with data.activateDiagnostics (dialog, ideAlive, ideResponding, runtimeAlive, systemState) instead of waiting forever.

tools.name: GetBuildErrors
tools.description: Read the compiler messages currently shown in the XAE Error List: data.counts {errors, warnings, messages}, data.errors[] and data.warnings[] (IncludeWarnings defaults to true; IncludeWarnings=false skips the warning toggle and saves 1-2 s); IncludeMessages=true adds data.messages[]. Items are {severity, code, description, project, file, line, column}. Counts are read from the summary buttons in English and zh-TW UI (zh-TW VS2022 'shown / total' labels report the total); other UI languages return ERRORLIST_UNAVAILABLE. In VS2022 the Error List scope filter is switched from Current Project / Current Document / Open Documents to Entire Solution before reading (left switched).

IncludeWarnings.description: Default on; -IncludeWarnings:$false skips the warning toggle (saves 1-2 s of UIA). Also reads warning rows (data.warnings, always present when on, possibly empty).

TimeoutSec.description: Hard limit for the UI Automation scan. Default 30.

tools.name: GetIdeInfo
tools.description: Return version, edition, open solution, ITcSysManager availability and the active solution platform / configuration (solutionPlatform, solutionConfiguration; null when unreadable) of the connected IDE. Cheap connectivity check; fails with NOT_CONNECTED before ConnectIde.

tools.name: GetIoTree
tools.description: Reads the current I/O device tree (TIID subtree) and returns as JSON.

tools.name: GetPlcState
tools.description: Read the PLC runtime state (Run/Stop/...) on the connected ADS port.

tools.name: GetPouCode
tools.description: Read the source of a PLC object: POU, DUT, GVL, interface, method ... data.objectKind (POU / DUT / GVL / ITF / METHOD / ACTION / PROPERTY_GET / ... / UNKNOWN, from the tree item ItemType; data.itemType, data.itemTypeName), data.pouType (Program / Function / FunctionBlock for a POU, Struct / Enum / Union / Alias for a DUT), data.language (ST / LD / FBD ..., null for DUT / GVL / ITF), data.hasImplementation, data.implementationReadable, data.declaration, data.implementation. hasImplementation=false (DUT, GVL, ITF, property): implementation is null because the object has no implementation part, the whole source is in declaration. A POU returns an implementation string (empty when there is no code; LD / FBD return XAE XML, not ST); implementationReadable=false means it has an implementation part that did not come back as text (implementation null). A COM call that throws, or a declaration that reads null, returns POU_READ_FAILED.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to read.

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy). Format on 4024 and 4026: TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<name>; DUT ...^DUTs^<name>, GVL ...^GVLs^<name>. Use GetProjectTree with PlcOnly=true to list paths.

tools.name: GetProjectTree
tools.description: Read the project tree. Every node has name, path, type, itemType, subType and children; path can be passed as-is to GetPouCode / WritePouCode PouPath. type is the item kind from ItemType (Project, Folder, FunctionBlock, Function, Program, Dut, Gvl, Task, References ...) or the numeric ItemType when unknown (itemType / subType are also returned as numbers). The PLC node TIPC^<Plc> also lists "<Plc> Project" with its POUs, DUTs and GVLs folders (on 4024 and 4026 the project node is hidden from enumeration and is added by path). Depth (default 4) = levels below each root, enough for TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<POU>; a node at the depth limit that still has children comes back with children=[] and truncated=true. PlcOnly=true returns only the TIPC subtree.

Depth.description: Levels below each root node (1-10, default 4). 4 reaches the POUs: TIPC(0)^<Plc>(1)^<Plc> Project(2)^POUs(3)^<POU>(4). Nodes at the limit that have children return truncated=true.

PlcOnly.description: true = return only the TIPC (PLC) subtree.

tools.name: GetSymbols
tools.description: List the PLC symbols of the connected runtime, optionally filtered by a substring (Filter): data is an array (empty when nothing matches) of {path, type, size, comment}, plus enumValues (member name -> value) for enum types; the execution order is in the top-level order field. Use it to find exact variable paths and types before ReadVariable/WriteVariable.

tools.name: GetSystemState
tools.description: Read the TwinCAT system state (Run/Config) of a target over ADS port 10000. AmsNetId defaults to the IDE target (ConnectIde), then the ADS session (ConnectAds), then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1; data.amsNetId / data.netIdSource tell which one was used. netIdSource=local means you read the local TwinCAT system, which is usually NOT your target.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to use the IDE target, then the ADS session, then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1 (see data.netIdSource).

tools.name: IoScan
tools.description: Scan the I/O devices (EtherCAT ...) of the target and add them to the I/O tree. Requires the target in Config mode.

tools.name: NewProject
tools.description: Create a new TwinCAT XAE solution with a PLC project and a default MAIN program; the module then works on the new solution. BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): the new solution (never built yet) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the project name; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

Path.description: Directory to create the project in. Defaults to current directory.

tools.name: NewTestCase
tools.description: Build a test case object for RunTest/RunTestCycle. Setup/Teardown are arrays of {Path, Value} writes; Assertions are {Path, Operator, Expected} with Operator one of Equal (default), NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse. Pure data, no IDE/PLC access.

Setup.description: Writes before the test: array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":1} (keys Path = PLC symbol path, Value = value to write, converted to the PLC type).

Teardown.description: Writes after the test (also run when the test fails): array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":0} (keys Path, Value).

WaitMs.description: Wait duration in milliseconds before assertions.

Assertions.description: Checks after WaitMs: array of {"Path":"MAIN.y","Operator":"Equal","Expected":1}. Keys: Path (PLC symbol path), Operator (optional, default Equal; one of Equal, NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse), Expected (omit for IsTrue/IsFalse). Short forms like "eq"/"gt" are NOT accepted.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Open a solution (.sln) in the connected IDE and wait until the TwinCAT project is loaded.

tools.name: PlcLogin
tools.description: Login to the PLC project and download the program in one call (PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS Regular, prompts answered by SilentMode, no dialogs). Use after a successful BuildProject when TwinCAT is already in Run; EnableConfig Force=true already includes this step. With several PLC projects pass PlcProjectPath (PLC name such as FrameworkUnitTest or tree path); without it PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS is returned instead of logging into the first PLC. data.adsPort is the PLC's ADS port. Refused with BUILD_REQUIRED (every LoginMode, nothing sent to the IDE) while the solution needs a complete BuildProject (after a platform switch, a build that was not a complete success, #56, or a code / project change by WritePouCode, AddPou, AddDut, AddGvl, AddLibrary, NewProject or ResetSolution, #65; error.hint names the tool and object): XAE compiles before a login by itself, but that compile is not checked.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project). Required when the solution has more than one PLC project.

LoginMode.description: Regular (default): PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_REGULAR - login, download only when the runtime has no program (XAE decides). Download: FORCEDOWNLOAD - always a full download (used by Send-TcPlcProgram). OnlineChange: FORCEONLINECHANGE. SILENT (256) is only OR-ed in with -SilentFlag.

SilentFlag.description: OR PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_SILENT (256) into the login flags. Off by default: prompts are answered by the global ITcAutomationSettings.SilentMode that Connect-TcIde enables.

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound of the Login COM call (Invoke-TcComRetry -TimeoutSec), default 300. Enable-TcConfig passes the rest of its overall -TimeoutSec budget.

tools.name: PlcLogout
tools.description: Log out of the PLC project (the runtime keeps running). With several PLC projects pass PlcProjectPath (PLC name or tree path); without it PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS. data.plcProjectPath / data.adsPort tell which PLC was logged out.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project). Required when the solution has more than one PLC project.

tools.name: ReadVariable
tools.description: Read one or more PLC variables by symbol path (e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter","GVL.bRun"]) via ADS. Path is always an array, even for a single variable. One path: data is the entry (an unknown symbol fails with SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND); several paths: data is an array with one entry per path, a path that could not be read is {path, error, code, hint} inside it, so check every entry. Each entry has path, value, type: BOOL/integers/REAL/STRING are plain values; TIME/TOD, LTIME/LTOD, DATE/DT, LDATE/LDT return the IEC literal in value ("T#6s", "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00") plus the raw integer in ms (TIME/TOD), ns (LTIME/LTOD/LDATE/LDT) or unix (DATE/DT); enums return the integer in value plus the member name in name; STRUCT/ARRAY return the raw bytes in value plus size. Requires ConnectAds (auto-reconnects after EnableConfig).

Path.description: Array of PLC symbol paths, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"]. Always an array, also for a single variable.

tools.name: ResetSolution
tools.description: Reload every project file from disk: dismisses the reload prompt if it is up (data.dismissedReloadPrompt). The XAE project prompt "The project file ... has been modified outside of TwinCAT XAE. Do you want to reload the project?" (a rewritten .plcproj; GetIdeModalDialog kind reload-prompt, reloadTarget project) is answered Yes by dialog control id (any UI language) and XAE reloads the project itself: then only ConnectIde runs again, no close / reopen (data.answeredYes=true, data.reopenedSolution=false, data.reloadTarget). Otherwise it closes all documents without saving (data.closedDocuments), Solution.Close, Solution.Open of the same .sln on the same IDE, then ConnectIde again (20-25 s in total, data.totalSec). Use right after .TcPOU / .plcproj files were changed ON DISK by another tool while they are open in an XAE editor: otherwise XAE shows the modal "File has been changed outside the environment. Reload the new file?" (GetIdeModalDialog kind reload-prompt) and every call blocks. A file that is not open in an editor is picked up automatically within ~5 s and needs no call; WritePouCode writes the IDE edit buffer through COM and never needs it (the file on disk is only written on save / BuildProject). Any other modal dialog is reported as IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. The ADS connection is kept. BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a reload from disk (the files may have been changed outside the module) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the .sln; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

SolutionPath.description: .sln to reopen. Default: the solution ConnectIde / OpenProject opened.

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound for each of Documents.CloseAll, Solution.Close and Solution.Open in seconds (default 120).

tools.name: RunTest
tools.description: Execute one test case created with NewTestCase (setup writes -> wait -> assertions -> teardown writes) against the connected PLC. Requires ConnectAds.

TestCase.description: A test case object as returned by NewTestCase.

tools.name: RunTestCycle
tools.description: Builds, activates (TwinCAT restart) and runs the PLC: changes the running machine. Confirm with the user first. Full automated test cycle: build (unless SkipBuild), activate configuration, login, run every test case from NewTestCase, then stop the PLC (unless KeepRunning). Returns per-test results. Can take many minutes (timeout 900 s).

TestCases.description: Array of test case objects as returned by NewTestCase.

SkipBuild.description: Skip the build step (if already built).

KeepRunning.description: Don't stop the PLC after tests complete.

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Passed to its BuildProject and EnableConfig steps: accept unresolved libraries (LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED) as success. Only when the user accepts that the PLC code may not have been compiled.

tools.name: SendPlcProgram
tools.description: Download the compiled PLC program to the target (alias of PlcLogin: Login+Download without dialogs). Refused with BUILD_REQUIRED like PlcLogin.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project. Default auto-detects from TIPC.

tools.name: SetPlcState
tools.description: Switch the PLC runtime to Run, Stop or Reset and wait for the state. WARNING: on a UmRT (user-mode runtime) target, Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm and you must EnableConfig again. Prefer Run/Stop.

State.description: Run, Stop or Reset. Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm on a UmRT target.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum wait for Run/Stop to be reached. Default 30.

tools.name: SetSystemState
tools.description: Switch TwinCAT to Run or Config via ADS WriteControl (no StartRestartTwinCAT dialog) and poll until the state is reached. Switching to Config stops the runtime: all outputs go to zero. Does not download the PLC program; EnableConfig Force=true is the usual choice. Run sends AdsState Reset (2) and Config sends Reconfig (16) on port 10000 (data.sentAdsState; Run (5) is refused there with ADS 0x701). After the target state is seen it must hold for SettleSec (default 3 s) and is read back (data.readbackState, data.stateTrace): a runtime that falls back to Config (e.g. ADS 1809 symbol version invalid) returns SYSTEM_STATE_MISMATCH, never success. When the original state equals the target (Run -> Run restart) the system must first be seen leaving it. data: originalState, finalState, reached, held, leftOriginal, latencyMs; when it stays in / falls back to Config the license server (ADS port 30) is read and expired / invalid licenses are put into error.hint and data.licenses.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID. Optional; resolved from the IDE target, then the ADS session. Never falls back to the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time to wait for the target state. Default 60.

SettleSec.description: Seconds the reached state must hold before success (sampled every 250 ms, then read back). Default 3; 0 = final readback only.

tools.name: SetTarget
tools.description: Set the target AmsNetId (ITcSysManager.SetTargetNetId, always done first: data.amsNetId, data.targetSet=true even when the result is an error) and make the active solution platform follow the target. The target decides the platform: the active solution platform must match it (Usermode Runtime / UmRT and TwinCAT/BSD = 'TwinCAT OS (x64)', Windows RT target = 'TwinCAT RT (x64)'), otherwise EnableConfig fails with ACTIVATE_FAILED. Before switching, the project platform of the .tsproj under the chosen solution platform is checked: a solution platform that maps to another project platform (e.g. 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' -> 'TwinCAT OS (ARMT2)') returns PLATFORM_PROJECT_MISMATCH and nothing is switched (data.platformMap). With Platform that platform is activated for Configuration (default Release; data.platformCheck='parameter'). Without Platform the platform the target reports through TARGETINFO (ADS port 200, IG 0x700) is activated ('target'); not in the solution -> PLATFORM_NOT_FOUND. Target without TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702, data.adsError) and no Platform -> PLATFORM_UNKNOWN (NetId already set; nothing guessed). NoPlatformSwitch=true only sets the NetId ('disabled'). Returns data.platform (solution platform) / projectPlatform (active .tsproj) / requestedProjectPlatform / platformChanged / targetPlatform / targetPlatformSource and, when a platform was activated, configuration / previousPlatform / availablePlatforms / projectCheck / platformMap.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID (e.g., "127.0.0.1.1.1" for local).

Platform.description: Solution platform to activate, e.g. 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' (Usermode Runtime / UmRT, TwinCAT/BSD) or 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' (Windows RT). Omit to follow the platform the target reports (TARGETINFO); a target without TARGETINFO then returns PLATFORM_UNKNOWN.

Configuration.description: Solution configuration name. With Platform default Release; for the automatic switch the active configuration.

NoPlatformSwitch.description: true = only set the target NetId; never touch the solution platform and never return PLATFORM_UNKNOWN.

tools.name: SetVariableLink
tools.description: Links a PLC variable to an I/O channel.

tools.name: WatchVariable
tools.description: Poll one or more PLC variables (Path is an array; every round reads each path in order) every IntervalMs. Without Until it samples for DurationMs (default 2000). With Until it waits for a condition '<Path> <op> <value>' (op: == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5' or 'MAIN.bDone == TRUE'; <Path> must be one of Path) and returns as soon as it holds or after UntilTimeoutMs (default 5000): data.untilMet, untilSample, elapsedMs. Numbers compare numerically, TRUE/FALSE as booleans, other values as case-insensitive text; a failed read never satisfies the condition. Only the last KeepLast samples are returned (default 20 with Until, 50 without); sampleCount is the total and truncated tells whether older samples were dropped. Single-path samples are {timestamp, value} plus ms/ns/unix for TIME/DATE types and name for enums (same conversion as ReadVariable; a numeric Until value compares with that raw integer, text with the IEC literal / enum member name), multi-path samples {timestamp, values:{<path>:<value>}}. Use Until instead of a long DurationMs or repeated ReadVariable calls. Requires ConnectAds.

Path.description: One or more variable paths to monitor, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"] or ["MAIN.fActual","MAIN.bDone"]. Always an array.

IntervalMs.description: Delay between sampling rounds in milliseconds. Default: 100.

DurationMs.description: Sampling duration in ms when Until is not given (default 2000).

Until.description: Stop condition '<Path> <op> <value>' with op one of == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5'. <Path> must be in Path (case-insensitive).

UntilTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in ms to wait for Until before returning untilMet=false. Default 5000.

TimeoutMs.description: Legacy alias of UntilTimeoutMs; used only when UntilTimeoutMs is not given.

KeepLast.description: Number of most recent samples to return. 0 = auto (20 with Until, 50 without). sampleCount still counts every round; truncated=true when older samples were dropped.

tools.name: WritePouCode
tools.description: Write Declaration and/or Implementation of an existing PLC object through the XAE edit buffer (no ResetSolution needed). DUT / GVL / ITF / property have only a declaration: passing Implementation for one of them returns INVALID_PARAMS and nothing is written (data.objectKind; for a property the hint points to its ^Get / ^Set accessor); send the whole TYPE ... END_TYPE / VAR_GLOBAL ... END_VAR as Declaration. data: pouPath, resolvedBy, objectKind, updated[]. Run BuildProject afterwards to compile. BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a write (also one that failed half way) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the object; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to write to.

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy). Format on 4024 and 4026: TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<name>; DUT ...^DUTs^<name>, GVL ...^GVLs^<name>. Use GetProjectTree with PlcOnly=true to list paths.

tools.name: WriteVariable
tools.description: Write a single PLC variable by symbol path via ADS. Writes directly into the running PLC; may drive outputs or axes. Confirm with the user first. Value is converted to the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool for BOOL, number for integer/REAL types, string for STRING; TIME/TOD take an IEC literal ("T#6s", "T#1m30s500ms", "TOD#12:30:00"; integer ms also accepted), LTIME/LTOD "LTIME#1us" (or integer ns), DATE/DT "D#2026-10-20" / "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00" / ISO 8601 (or integer seconds since 1970), enums an integer or the member name. STRUCT/ARRAY cannot be written as a whole (TYPE_MISMATCH): write their members. data.written is the value actually written: the normalized literal for time types ("T#6000ms" -> "T#6s", raw integer in ms/ns/unix), the converted number otherwise, plus name for enums. Requires ConnectAds.

Value.description: New value matching the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool (BOOL), number (integer/REAL/LREAL), string (STRING). TIME/TOD: "T#6s" / "T#1m30s500ms" / "TOD#12:30:00" (integer ms also accepted); LTIME/LTOD: "LTIME#1us" (or integer ns); DATE/DT: "D#2026-10-20", "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00" or ISO 8601 (or integer seconds since 1970); LDATE/LDT: "LDT#..." (or integer ns); enum: integer or member name ("READY").
